name: PiggieTV
description: Server-side cache and integration endpoints for the PiggieTV web client.

versions.changelog: Allows large Metadata Quality indexed-store migrations to finish while retaining a bounded inactivity watchdog for stalled initialization.

Adds the indexed Metadata Quality store, bounded AI-assisted review, native administration APIs, account backup/profile support, Grand Comics Database and expanded Reading metadata providers, plus playback and diagnostics hardening for Jellyfin 10.11.11.
Starts the canonical PiggieTV 0.5 release line with recommendation policy v2 and authoritative cross-library relationships while preserving PiggieTV API v1 and featured cache v7 compatibility.
